title: The lead's journal appends are not narrowed
situation: 0059 proposed withholding the journal's appending verbs from the lead, because in one evaluation scenario the lead recorded its recommendation as an open decision. That was a test scenario, the entry was a reasonable recommendation marked open, and no real cut has shown it.
decision: Not narrowed. The lead keeps the journal's appending verbs; reconsider only if a real cut shows harm from it.
consequences: 0059 is withdrawn; the typed-handoffs cut carries 0064 and the removal 0068 names.
